# hvir

A lightweight, view-first workbench for agentic development.

hvir is an Electron desktop application that brings together a terminal, Git-aware views, SSH, and a document/code viewer into a single workbench tuned for working alongside coding agents.

## Features

- **View-first workbench** — a document and code viewer built on CodeMirror with Shiki syntax highlighting, Markdown, task lists, and Mermaid diagrams.
- **Integrated terminals** — native PTYs via `node-pty`, plus a web-based terminal backed by `ghostty-web`, with themeable presentation and split/move support.
- **Git-aware workflows** — first-class Git workflow, diff/merge views (`@codemirror/merge`), and workspace-remote awareness.
- **SSH support** — remote workspaces via `ssh2`, with acceptance tooling for real hosts.
- **Cross-platform** — packaged for macOS (pkg) and Linux (deb) on x64 and arm64.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** ≥ 24
- **npm** (matching the bundled `package-lock.json`)
- Platform toolchains for native module rebuilds (Xcode Command Line Tools on macOS; `build-essential` and `python3` on Linux).

## Getting started

```bash
# Install dependencies (also installs Electron runtime and rebuilds native modules)
npm install

# Run the app in development
npm run dev
```

## Building

```bash
# Type-check and build renderer + main bundles
npm run build

# Produce a directory build (no installer)
npm run build:dir

# Platform installers
npm run pack:mac:arm64
npm run pack:linux:x64
npm run pack:linux:arm64
```

## Quality gates

```bash
npm run lint             # ESLint
npm run typecheck        # tsc for node and web projects
npm test                 # Vitest
npm run format:check     # Prettier
npm run verify           # Seams + ADRs + architecture + lint + typecheck + tests
```

Additional targeted checks include `npm run check-seams`, `npm run check-adrs`, and `npm run architecture:check`.

### Smoke and acceptance

```bash
npm run smoke                 # Full smoke suite (built once, then all scenarios)
npm run smoke:macos           # macOS-focused subset
npm run smoke:scenario -- <scenario-name>
npm run acceptance:ssh:macos  # macOS SSH acceptance
```

Mutation testing is available via `npm run test:mutation` (Stryker).

## Project layout

```
src/
  main/       Electron main process
  preload/    Preload scripts
  renderer/   React 19 renderer (CodeMirror, Shiki, Mermaid, ghostty-web)
  shared/    Cross-process contracts and utilities
  workers/    Background workers
packages/     Local workspace packages (e.g. @hvir/rename-noreplace)
scripts/      Build, smoke, and project-management scripts
test/         Test suites
build/        Build assets
```

Configuration lives at the repo root: `electron.vite.config.ts`, `electron-builder.yml`, `vitest.config.ts`, `stryker.config.json`, `eslint.config.mjs`, and the `tsconfig.*.json` family.

## Git hooks

Install the repository's Git hooks with:

```bash
npm run hooks:install
```

## License

Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). Third-party notices are collected in [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Links

- Homepage: <https://github.com/jarmak-personal/hvir>
- Issues: <https://github.com/jarmak-personal/hvir/issues>

+# hvir
+
+A lightweight, view-first workbench for agentic development.
+
+hvir is an Electron desktop application that brings together a terminal, Git-aware views, SSH, and a document/code viewer into a single workbench tuned for working alongside coding agents.
+
+## Features
+
+- **View-first workbench** — a document and code viewer built on CodeMirror with Shiki syntax highlighting, Markdown, task lists, and Mermaid diagrams.
+- **Integrated terminals** — native PTYs via `node-pty`, plus a web-based terminal backed by `ghostty-web`, with themeable presentation and split/move support.
+- **Git-aware workflows** — first-class Git workflow, diff/merge views (`@codemirror/merge`), and workspace-remote awareness.
+- **SSH support** — remote workspaces via `ssh2`, with acceptance tooling for real hosts.
+- **Cross-platform** — packaged for macOS (pkg) and Linux (deb) on x64 and arm64.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- **Node.js** ≥ 24
+- **npm** (matching the bundled `package-lock.json`)
+- Platform toolchains for native module rebuilds (Xcode Command Line Tools on macOS; `build-essential` and `python3` on Linux).
+
+## Getting started
+
+```bash
+# Install dependencies (also installs Electron runtime and rebuilds native modules)
+npm install
+
+# Run the app in development
+npm run dev
+```
+
+## Building
+
+```bash
+# Type-check and build renderer + main bundles
+npm run build
+
+# Produce a directory build (no installer)
+npm run build:dir
+
+# Platform installers
+npm run pack:mac:arm64
+npm run pack:linux:x64
+npm run pack:linux:arm64
+```
+
+## Quality gates
+
+```bash
+npm run lint             # ESLint
+npm run typecheck        # tsc for node and web projects
+npm test                 # Vitest
+npm run format:check     # Prettier
+npm run verify           # Seams + ADRs + architecture + lint + typecheck + tests
+```
+
+Additional targeted checks include `npm run check-seams`, `npm run check-adrs`, and `npm run architecture:check`.
+
+### Smoke and acceptance
+
+```bash
+npm run smoke                 # Full smoke suite (built once, then all scenarios)
+npm run smoke:macos           # macOS-focused subset
+npm run smoke:scenario -- <scenario-name>
+npm run acceptance:ssh:macos  # macOS SSH acceptance
+```
+
+Mutation testing is available via `npm run test:mutation` (Stryker).
+
+## Project layout
+

+src/
+  main/       Electron main process
+  preload/    Preload scripts
+  renderer/   React 19 renderer (CodeMirror, Shiki, Mermaid, ghostty-web)

+  workers/    Background workers
+packages/     Local workspace packages (e.g. @hvir/rename-noreplace)
+scripts/      Build, smoke, and project-management scripts
+test/         Test suites
+build/        Build assets
+```
